'''Fire teams''', also spelled '''Fire Teams''' were the smallest unit in the [[Imperial soldier]]s of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], consisting of two to three [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] which were part of [[Squad/Legends|squad]]s of five to ten. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later,<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> fire teams were also the smallest unit in the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. They consisted of anywhere between two and five troopers; between two and four fire teams made up a [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. Fire teams were usually led by a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] and worked in concert to defeat enemy forces by laying down cover fire while other fire teams flanked and routed out the enemy.

The [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had a similar subdivision among their squads, which were usually split into two and put in wedge positions to take into account all firing directions, with the team leader being at the tip of each "wedge."
